drivers.driver: Buffett considered but could not undertake roughly $25B for the property/casualty unit on the crisis weekend.
drivers.quote: Unfortunately, I can't do this deal. And don't waste your time with me, so go someplace else.

drivers.driver: He distinguished desirable operating businesses from financial-products obligations management did not adequately understand.
drivers.quote: I don't think anybody knew what they needed to know, including the management.

drivers.driver: The pressure and depth of the funding hole prevented a workable transaction despite interest in selected units.
drivers.quote: the pressures were such, and the hole was deep enough, that they simply couldn't get it worked out

entry_valuation_stated: No issuer-specific investor-stated intrinsic value or entry multiple recovered; pack valuation is analyst reconstruction.
outcome_note: Direct September-weekend approach and refusal verified in Buffett's September 15, 2009 CNBC interview. This controls the proposed 2008 rescue/asset transaction, not lifetime nonownership: Berkshire later bought AIG assets, including the 2013 specialty-insurance business. This is a direction/discipline test, not a return forecast. Nonholding evidence is scoped to the parent discretionary portfolio and the tested window; quarterly 13Fs cannot prove absence of every intraperiod trade, nonreportable instrument, subsidiary client holding or personal investment.
pack_quality_notes: Exact stock close and executable private deal terms unavailable. Refusal preceded the requested desk date; private call is not inserted into docs. The roughly $25B unit-price recollection is key-only. Silent controls do not have three authentic stated reasons; the three slots distinguish action, ownership verification and grading boundary rather than fabricate quotes.
